fortress-B8F_entrance.questName: [妖精]要塞八层门口(前导任务)
fortress-B8F_entrance._TIPS:
本任务是前导任务: 反复刷要塞八层门口的两个怪并开箱, 直到开箱检测到"妖精"杂物.
一旦检测到, 脚本会自动切换到"[妖精]要塞八层陷阱"并开始循环刷取, 之后不再回到本任务.
前置条件: 必须通关第三章; 要塞八层右下区块必须是陷阱房.
标记要求: 在要塞入口地图的x=13, y=34处做标记; 在8F地图的x=16, y=7处做标记.

This is the lead task: keep farming the two enemies at the Fortress Zone 8 entrance and opening chests until a "Faerie" junk item is detected.
Once detected, the script automatically switches to "[Faerie] Fortress Zone 8 Trap" and starts the farming loop; it will not come back to this task.
Prerequisites: Chapter 3 must be cleared, and the bottom-right block of Fortress Zone 8 must be a trap room.
Markers: place a marker at x=13, y=34 on the Fortress entrance map, and another at x=16, y=7 on the 8F map.

조건: 3장 완료, 요새 8층 오른쪽 아래 구역이 함정 방이어야 합니다.
지도 표식: 요새 입구 X=13, Y=34 및 8층 X=16, Y=7.

fortress-B8F_trap.questName: [妖精]要塞八层陷阱(后续任务)
fortress-B8F_trap._TIPS:
本任务是后续任务, 负责循环刷取: 反复刷门口的两只怪物和陷阱房的怪物.
通常由"[妖精]要塞八层门口"检测到妖精杂物后自动切换过来, 也可以直接启动本任务.

要塞8刷小精灵的准备流程:
这是不回城的队伍, 因此推荐忍者盗贼面具+物理长矛/弓箭+王女或者夏莉莉奶.
在"设置setting""自动移动auto-moving"中关闭所有选项.

This is the follow-up task and performs the farming loop: repeatedly farm the two enemies at the entrance and the enemies in the trap room.
It is normally entered automatically after "[Faerie] Fortress Zone 8" detects the Faerie junk, but can also be started directly.

Preparation for farming Faeries in Fortress Zone 8:
Since this party does not return to town, Ninja, Rogue and Masked One, plus a physical spear/bow and Princess or Sheliri as healer, are recommended.
In "Settings" > "Auto-Moving", turn off all options.

마을로 돌아오지 않는 파티입니다. 닌자·도적·가면 캐릭터, 물리 창/활 사용자와 황녀 또는 셰리리 회복 담당을 권장합니다. 게임 설정의 자동 이동 항목은 모두 끄세요.

FFXI-Org._TIPS:
请按照如下步骤设置:
1 购买9999个鹤嘴锄并保存在仓库里
2 六人队伍脱掉所有装备, 然后尽可能多的携带鹤嘴锄
3 在王城的工会里新建一个队伍, 并命名为FFXIStone.
4 前往活动地图2F, 在哈肯正对的矿点前, 打上标记.
5 确保这是该层唯一的标记.
6 副本或主城中启动脚本.
注意, 如果在楼层选择处卡住无法继续, 请尝试开启所有哈肯.

Please follow these steps to set it up:
1 Purchase 9,999 pickaxes and keep them in storage.
2 Have your six-person party remove all equipment, then carry as many pickaxes as possible.
3 Create a new party at the Guild in the Royal Capital and name it "FFXIStone".
4 Go to the 2F event map and place a marker in front of the mining spot directly facing Harken.
5 Ensure this is the only marker on that floor.
6 Start the script from inside the dungeon or the city.
FFXI-Org._TIPS_ko_KR:
설정 순서:
1. 곡괭이 9,999개를 구매해 창고에 보관하세요.
2. 6인 파티의 장비를 모두 벗기고 곡괭이를 최대한 많이 소지하세요.
3. 왕도의 길드에서 FFXIStone이라는 이름의 파티를 만드세요.
4. 이벤트 지도 2층에서 하켄을 정면으로 바라보는 채굴 지점 앞에 표식을 설정하세요.
5. 해당 층의 유일한 표식이어야 합니다.
6. 던전 또는 도시에서 시작하세요.
층 선택 화면에서 멈추면 하켄을 모두 개방해 보세요.
FFXI-Org._TIPS_en_US:
Please follow these steps to set it up:
1 Purchase 9,999 pickaxes and keep them in storage.
2 Have your six-person party remove all equipment, then carry as many pickaxes as possible.
3 Create a new party at the Guild in the Royal Capital and name it "FFXIStone".
4 Go to the 2F event map and place a marker in front of the mining spot directly facing Harken.
5 Ensure this is the only marker on that floor.
6 Start the script from inside the dungeon or the city.
If floor selection gets stuck, try unlocking all Harkens.

只会拿去仓库中存在的鱼饵, 脚本不会购买鱼饵.

Returning to town to fetch bait is now supported.

Only bait already in storage is used; the script will not buy bait.
This task can currently only be started from the main city or the fishing interface; other screens will not work.
